comment: Where the file viewer's TextMate grammars come from. Each source is a git repository at a pinned commit; every folder matched by `extensions` is a VS Code extension whose package.json says which languages it knows (file extensions, names, first lines) and which grammar colors them. Run import_grammars.py after changing this file.

sources.name: Visual Studio Code
sources.license: MIT; each grammar's own origin and license is in its extension's cgmanifest.json
